THE ASSIGNMENT
ContextContributionRelated expertise

IFC flagship project with the UK Government and the European Union

The question
behind the work.

Supported effective consultation mechanisms, governance and institutional reform to improve the investment climate of Bangladesh — business regulation reforms, regulatory framework, and institutional reforms to increase private investment in industrial land.

Analytical contribution.

  1. 01

    Led the research and evaluation team and managed monitoring and implementation activities.

  2. 02

    Designed and implemented a Result Based Measurement and M&E framework and tools.

  3. 03

    Created platforms for broad-based public-private dialogue on policy formulation and generated reform options.

  4. 04

    Implemented and evaluated 20 simplification and automation projects — including IRC renewal, IRC/ERC issuance, E-TIN automation of tax registration, BSTI certification mark registration, Board of Investment processes, Business Confidence Survey 2014–16, DPDT designs and trademarks, and e-payments.
